descriptions.preferred: This cultivar has very vivid red new foliage which turns to a dark purple red and holds its color well throughout the summer, especially in full sun, though the leaves become green-hued by late summer. All new leaves appearing during the summer have the vivid red of the spring foliage and contrast well with the darker red background of older leaves. The leaves have five or seven lobes, are divided two-thirds to three-quarters of the way to the leaf base, and measure 7-9 cm long and 9-10 cm wide. Each lobe is ovate with a pointed tip, and the margins are finely and evenly double toothed. The strong red petioles are about 3 cm long. This moderately strong grower reaches only 4-5 m high so is suitable for smaller gardens. It is often multistemmed and forms a mediumsized upright bush or tree. 'Red Flash' originated at the Fratelli Gilardelli Nursery near Milan, Italy. the leaf measuring 5-9 cm long but only 2-4 mm wide. The lobes separate entirely to the leaf base. The total spread of the leaf is 10-14 cm. The effect of these delicate leaves is lacelike. The petioles are 2-3 cm long. On oneor two-year-old wood of a vigorous tree, the leaf size is larger and the lobes broader with toothed margins, while leaves on older wood tend to be quite a bit smaller and almost untoothed. It should be noted that on current-year wood, when the growth is vigorous, the leaves almost approach the typical palmatum form, a common occurrence in many cultivars of the Linearilobum Group. Some people think the cultivar is reverting and prune off this vigorous growth. This is a mistake, for the cultivar will produce its typical foliage in the next season. The spring and early summer coloration of red maroon holds quite well through the hot weather. In late summer it deepens into a more purplish tone. In direct sun it bronzes with green undertones somewhat late in the season. However, the color holds much better and sunburns less than the color of the older standard cultivar

rhs.description: A deciduous, upright Japanese maple about 4-5m tall, often multistemmed. Young leaves emerge vivid red with 5 to 7 lobes and pointed tips to 9cm long, turning dark purple-red towards summer then becoming greenish during late summer before the autumn tints of crimson-red

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this amoenum group have large, palm-shaped leaves with finely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to aphids and scale insects , including horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。

resistance.pest: 可能易受蚜虫和介壳虫侵害，包括七叶树介壳虫。
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 落叶、直立生长的日本枫，株高约 4-5 米，常为多主干。幼叶萌发时呈鲜红色，具 5 至 7 裂，裂片先端尖，叶长可达 9 厘米；至夏季转为深紫红色，夏末又略转带绿色，秋季呈深绯红色。

attributes.suggested_uses: 适合城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、花境及花坛。
attributes.hort_group_description: 此 amoenum 类群中的 Acer 品种具有大型掌状叶，叶缘具细锯齿。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种春季新叶呈非常鲜艳的红色，随后转为深紫红色，整个夏季保色性很好，尤其在全日照条件下表现更佳，不过到夏末叶色会略带绿色。夏季新抽生的叶片仍保持春叶那种鲜艳的红色，与较老叶片形成的深红背景对比鲜明。叶片具 5 或 7 个裂片，裂至叶基的约 2/3 至 3/4 处，长 7 至 9 厘米，宽 9 至 10 厘米。各裂片为卵形，先端尖，边缘具细密而均匀的重锯齿。强健的红色叶柄长约 3 厘米。该品种生长势中等偏强，但株高仅达 4 至 5 米，因此适合较小型庭院。常呈多干状，形成中等大小的直立灌木或小乔木。'Red Flash' 起源于意大利米兰附近的 Fratelli Gilardelli 苗圃。 其叶片长 5 至 9 厘米，但裂片宽仅 2 至 4 毫米，裂片完全分离至叶基，整片叶展开宽度为 10 至 14 厘米，这种纤细叶形呈现出蕾丝般的效果。叶柄长 2 至 3 厘米。在生长旺盛树体的一至二年生枝上，叶片会更大、裂片更宽，且边缘具锯齿；而老枝上的叶片则往往明显较小，且几乎无锯齿。需要注意的是，在当年生旺盛枝条上，叶片形态几乎会接近典型的 palmatum 型，这在 Linearilobum Group 的许多品种中都很常见。有些人认为这是品种返祖而将这些强旺枝剪除，但这是错误的，因为该品种在下一生长季仍会恢复其典型叶形。春季至初夏的栗红色叶色在炎热天气下保持性相当好；到夏末则加深为更偏紫的色调。在直射日光下，季末会带有一些铜色与绿色底调。不过，它的叶色保持性明显优于老的标准品种

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Red Flash' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Red Flash' Red Flash Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 Acer palmatum ‘Red Flash’ is a striking Italian introduction prized for its exceptionally vivid spring color. New growth emerges an intensely bright red in early spring, then matures to a rich, deep maroon as summer progresses. In fall, the foliage ignites again, turning a brilliant fire-engine red. This upright Japanese maple is expected to reach approximately 10 feet tall in 10 years, making it an excellent choice as a colorful focal point in the landscape. Still relatively new to the American market, ‘Red Flash’ shows tremendous promise. With its unmatched spring color and strong seasonal performance, it is poised to become a standout red upright standard among Japanese maples.
